facts.sentence: On Thursday, Nov 12, 1,589 of the 1,783 elevators AGSIST reads with the same delivery month both days posted a lower cash corn bid than Wednesday, 176 a higher one; 208 changed their basis, 14 weaker and 194 stronger.
facts.detail: 18 unchanged; median change 1¢ lower. Biggest state move: Colorado, 2¢ lower (25 elevators).
facts.unit: cents per bushel, median change in cash bid
facts.comparison: last posted bid on 2026-11-12 vs 2026-11-11, same board, crop and delivery period
facts.source: AGSIST elevator network, last posted bid per trading day (data/bids-prev)
